name: gwragedd annwn

attributes.attribute: the name of the Welsh lake maidens
chose to live with human men
any blow, even in play, made one leave

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The Gwragedd Annwn are the Welsh lake maidens, a kind of otherworld being. Most fairy women were a danger to human men. They drew men into their world, used them, and then left them behind. The Gwragedd Annwn were not like that. These lake maidens chose to live with human men and made excellent wives. One rule stood firm. No man may raise a hand against a lake maiden, not even in play. A single blow would make her leave her husband and children behind. She took all her fairy wealth and dove into the nearest lake.

okr.objective: Explain the Gwragedd Annwn, the Welsh lake maidens who could make good wives.
key_results: The source names them the Welsh lake maidens.
It compares them with fairy women who used and left men.
It says not a hand may be raised against one, not even in play.
It notes a lake maiden who was struck left with all her fairy wealth.
